{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially when sentiment is negative or neutral).",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if sentiment history shows persistent negative sentiment (e.g., -0.20 or -0.25) over recent days.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above or below recent 5-10 day average, pull toward historical mean.",
    "Lower forecast for long horizons (e.g., 30-day) when sentiment is weak or negative, as market tends to correct downward.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent sentiment shifts — e.g., if sentiment turns positive after negative streak, adjust upward gradually.",
    "Avoid overreacting to single-day spikes — use 3-5 day moving average to smooth out noise before forecasting.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast, reduce future forecast by 5-10% for next period to account for underestimation bias.",
    "If true outcome is consistently above forecast, increase future forecast by 5-10% to account for overestimation bias."
  ]
}
